issues.evidence: The Tibetan says only 'ངེས་པར་འབྱུང་' (definitely emerges), with no stated source of emergence; english_academic has 'definitely emerge'. The commentaries read it as emerging from extremes: bo-mipham 1-12 'མཐའ་ཐམས་ཅད་ལས་ངེས་པར་འབྱུང་' (from all extremes) and bo-khenrab 1-12 'སྲིད་ཞིའི་མཐའ་ལས་ངེས་པར་འབྱུང་' (from the extremes of existence and peace). 'भव से' restricts it to existence/saṃsāra alone and adds content the root does not state.
issues.fix: निश्चित ही निःसृत हो जाता है

issues.evidence: Tibetan 'སངས་རྒྱས་རིང་བསྲེལ' is a single phrase whose locked rendering is 'बुद्ध-अवशेष'. The translation merges it with the locked rendering of the sub-term 'རིང་བསྲེལ' (शरीर-धातु) through an invented 'रूपी' apposition, which the Tibetan does not have and which reads as a different, doubled referent.
